bias.zh: 短线偏空 · 逼近 $160 转折点

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 4% on Oct 12 to $162.23, down 17% in five sessions, and has only 66 sessions of history, so there is no 100-day average yet. It is below its 5-day ($172.5) and its 10 and 30-day averages (both near $181). MACD has been below its signal since Sep 28 and is now below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7, and RSI is 39.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 10月12日下跌 4%，收于 $162.23，五个交易日下跌 17%，上市仅 66 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于 5 日均线（$172.5）以及 10 日和 30 日均线（均约 $181）下方。MACD 自 9月28日起位于信号线下方，现已跌破零轴，抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空，RSI 为 39。

read.en: The July pivot at $160 is the next test, then $151.5 (Aug 24 pivot) and $145.6; the July low of $124.80 is the floor of its short history. Resistance is the 5-day average near $172.5 (Oct 8 high $177 above), then $181 (10 and 30-day averages) and the September highs at $196–200. Switch to the Seoul listing above for the longer trend.
read.zh: 下一测试为 7月转折点 $160，其次 $151.5（8月24日转折点）和 $145.6；7月低点 $124.80 为其短暂历史的底部。阻力为约 $172.5 的 5 日均线（其上为 10月8日高点 $177），其次 $181（10 日和 30 日均线）及 9月高点 $196–200。如需观察更长周期趋势，可切换至上方的首尔上市股票。

bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 9 月低点

read.en: SK hynix closed at ₩1,605,000 in Seoul on Oct 12, down 12% over its last five sessions and 46% below the June record. It broke the Sep 14 low of ₩1,671,000 and is below its 5, 10 and 30-day averages (₩1.72–1.76 million) and the falling 100-day (₩1.94 million), holding only above the 200-day (₩1.44 million). MACD is below its signal and zero line, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28, and RSI is 39.
read.zh: SK 海力士 10月12日在首尔收于 ₩1,605,000，近五个交易日下跌 12%，较 6月纪录高点低 46%。股价跌破 9月14日低点 ₩1,671,000，位于 5 日、10 日和 30 日均线（₩172万–176万）及下行的 100 日均线（₩194万）下方，仅守在 200 日均线（₩144万）之上。MACD 位于信号线及零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起看空，RSI 为 39。

read.en: Next support is the Sep 2 low of ₩1,558,000, then the 200-day average near ₩1,441,000 and the Aug 10 low of ₩1,373,000. The broken ₩1,671,000 level is first resistance, then the 30-day average near ₩1,749,000 and ₩1,837,000, which capped five swings in September.
